brief.description: The same knight character waving hello with his free hand while holding his shield, friendly smile, front three-quarter view, as a game character portrait

instructions.prompt: Game character portrait of the same knight character from the reference image, identical style and colors. He is shown from the knees up in a front three-quarter view, body turned slightly to his left and face toward the viewer. He waves hello with his raised right hand: an open blue-gloved palm at head height with five clearly separated fingers, empty, nothing in that hand. His left arm holds the round red shield with the gold rim, gold rivets and gold fleur-de-lis emblem in front of his left side. Friendly, warm smile showing teeth, big brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows. Keep every costume detail: blue helmet with gold trim, gold crest and red plume, blue plate armor with gold edges, gold cross on the chest, grey chainmail at the elbows, brown leather belt with gold buckle and pouch, sword sheathed or absent. Cartoon chibi proportions (large head, compact body), bold clean black outlines of even weight, flat cel shading with one soft highlight tone, saturated royal blue, gold-yellow and red palette. Centered, with padding on all sides, nothing cropped. Plain solid light-gray background. No text, no watermark.
instructions.styleNotes: Chibi cartoon game-asset style from the reference: bold uniform black outlines, flat cel shading with simple highlights, royal blue armor with gold trim, red plume, red-and-gold fleur-de-lis shield, plain light-gray background.
mustInclude: Same knight identity as the reference: blue helmet with gold trim and red plume, blue armor with gold edges, gold cross on chest, brown belt
Free hand raised in a clear waving-hello gesture with an open, empty hand
Holding the round red shield with gold rim and gold fleur-de-lis on the other arm
Framed as a game character portrait, centered with padding, nothing cropped
Same cartoon style, outline weight and palette as the reference
mustAvoid: Sword or any object in the waving hand
Extra or malformed fingers, hands or limbs
Cropping of the head, waving hand or shield
Text, watermark, logos or busy background
Realistic or painterly rendering that departs from the reference style

strengths: Character identity is preserved exactly: blue helmet with gold crest and red plume, blue plate armor with gold edges, gold chest cross, chainmail at elbows, brown belt with gold buckle and pouch
Clear, readable waving-hello gesture with an open, empty gloved hand at head height; five fingers, no extra digits
Round red shield with gold rim, rivets and fleur-de-lis is held on the other arm and matches the reference
Friendly open smile with the same face design as the reference
Outline weight, cel shading, chibi proportions and palette match the reference; plain light-gray background, no text or artifacts
Centered with padding on all sides; silhouette reads well at small size

issues.description: Framed as a full-body figure rather than a tighter character-portrait crop; the face and waving hand occupy a relatively small part of the frame for a portrait
The three-quarter turn is subtle; torso and feet are close to frontal, almost identical to the reference stance
No hand or grip is visible behind the shield, so the shield looks pinned to the forearm rather than actively held
Lower body and leg pose are copied almost verbatim from the reference, making the new pose feel less natural and less dynamic

suggestedCorrections: Crop to a knees-up or waist-up portrait so the smiling face and waving hand fill more of the frame, keeping padding around the plume, hand and shield
Rotate the torso and hips more clearly toward the viewer's right so the far shoulder is partly hidden, giving an unmistakable front three-quarter view
Show the gloved fingers of the shield hand gripping the shield's edge or strap
Give the legs a relaxed new stance with weight on one leg instead of repeating the reference stance
